title: Java / Spring security baseline
notes: Docket's own curated baseline for Java and Spring services, drawn from the weakness classes OWASP, the Spring Security reference and the OWASP Java cheat sheets all agree on, restated as controls a reader can check. Not a published standard and it does not claim to be one: `authority` is docket. Every control here is answerable by reading a repository.

controls.title: No credentials in source
controls.requirement: Passwords, keys and connection strings must come from the environment, a vault, or an externalised configuration source, never from committed source or a committed properties file.
controls.evidence_hint: spring.datasource.password or jwt.secret with a literal value in application.properties / application.yml; keystore passwords in code; credentials in a committed profile

controls.title: Dependency versions pinned
controls.requirement: Dependencies must be declared at exact versions, managed through a bill of materials or dependency-management block, rather than with version ranges or dynamic versions that resolve differently on each build.
controls.evidence_hint: pom.xml versions using LATEST or RELEASE; gradle dependencies with a + range; a spring-boot-dependencies BOM present or absent

controls.title: No Java deserialization of untrusted data
controls.requirement: ObjectInputStream, XMLDecoder and equivalent native deserializers must not read data that crossed a trust boundary. Received data must use a schema-validated format.
controls.evidence_hint: new ObjectInputStream(...).readObject(); XMLDecoder; a cache, session store or message consumer configured with a Java serialization codec; Jackson with default typing enabled

controls.title: Parameterised database queries
controls.requirement: SQL must be issued through PreparedStatement bind parameters, JPA named parameters or a query builder's parameter API. Query text must never be assembled by concatenation with request data.
controls.evidence_hint: Statement.executeQuery with a concatenated string; String.format into SQL; @Query with SpEL or string concatenation; createQuery built from a request value

controls.title: External commands built from an argument list
controls.requirement: Commands must use ProcessBuilder with a command list. Runtime.exec with a single assembled string, or a list whose elements interpolate request data, is command injection.
controls.evidence_hint: Runtime.getRuntime().exec(String); ProcessBuilder built from a concatenated string; sh -c passed a request value

controls.title: XML parsers hardened against external entities
controls.requirement: DocumentBuilderFactory, SAXParserFactory, XMLInputFactory and Transformer instances that read external XML must disable DTDs and external entity resolution explicitly; the platform defaults do not.
controls.evidence_hint: a factory created with no setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true); XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING absent; setExpandEntityReferences(true)

controls.title: No expression language evaluated on user input
controls.requirement: SpEL, OGNL, MVEL and template expressions must not be compiled or evaluated from values that came from a request.
controls.evidence_hint: SpelExpressionParser().parseExpression on request data; @Value or @Query carrying a request-derived expression; a template engine given user-supplied source

controls.title: Passwords hashed with a slow KDF
controls.requirement: Stored passwords must use Argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 with a per-user salt and a sane work factor. MessageDigest is not a password hash, and NoOpPasswordEncoder must not appear outside a test.
controls.citation: OWASP Password Storage Cheat Sheet; CWE-916
controls.evidence_hint: MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5"|"SHA-1") on a password; NoOpPasswordEncoder; BCryptPasswordEncoder and its strength argument

controls.title: Cryptographic randomness for security values
controls.requirement: Tokens, session ids, reset codes and nonces must come from SecureRandom. java.util.Random and Math.random are predictable from observed output.
controls.evidence_hint: new Random() or Math.random() used to build a token, id, otp or salt; UUID.randomUUID is acceptable, a time-seeded Random is not

controls.title: TLS validation not disabled
controls.requirement: Trust managers and hostname verifiers must not be replaced with permissive implementations. A trust-all TrustManager removes every protection TLS provides.
controls.evidence_hint: an X509TrustManager whose checkServerTrusted body is empty; HostnameVerifier returning true; setDefaultSSLSocketFactory with a permissive context

controls.title: Endpoints carry an authorisation decision
controls.requirement: Every non-public endpoint must be covered by an explicit authorisation rule — a security filter chain matcher, @PreAuthorize, or equivalent — rather than inheriting a permissive default.
controls.evidence_hint: anyRequest().permitAll(); a filter chain whose matchers miss a controller added later; controllers with no method security and no matching rule

controls.title: CSRF protection not blanket-disabled
controls.requirement: CSRF protection may only be disabled where the application is genuinely stateless and token-authenticated. Disabling it wholesale on a cookie-session application is exploitable.
controls.evidence_hint: csrf().disable() or csrf(AbstractHttpConfigurer::disable) together with session-based or cookie authentication elsewhere in the same config

controls.title: User-supplied paths contained
controls.requirement: A filename from a request must be normalised and then checked to be inside the intended directory, by path relativisation rather than by a string prefix comparison.
controls.evidence_hint: new File(dir, request.getParameter(...)); Paths.get with a request value; a startsWith() containment check; no normalize() before the check

controls.title: Management and diagnostic endpoints not public
controls.requirement: Actuator, JMX, heap dump and environment endpoints must be either disabled or restricted to an authenticated role and a management port, because they expose configuration and credentials.
controls.evidence_hint: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=*; env, heapdump or beans exposed; an actuator path permitted in the security config

controls.title: Stack traces not returned to clients
controls.requirement: Error responses must not include stack traces, SQL, or internal paths. Whitelabel and debug error pages must be off in a deployed configuration.
controls.evidence_hint: server.error.include-stacktrace=always; include-message=always; an @ExceptionHandler returning ex.getMessage() or a printStackTrace to the response

controls.title: Untrusted values not interpolated into log patterns
controls.requirement: User-controlled values must be passed as logging parameters, not concatenated into the message or format, and lookup evaluation in the logging configuration must be off.
controls.evidence_hint: log.info("user " + userInput); String.format built into a log call; a log4j2 configuration where message lookups are enabled; request headers or bodies logged whole
